patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used to pair descriptive text with product UI screenshots or illustrative graphics, creating dynamic content blocks.
A deep, dark purple/blue is used as a primary background, providing a strong contrast for bright accent colors (vibrant blue, green, and lighter purple) and white text.
Headings are set in a bold, sans-serif font (Poppins) with a clear hierarchy, often accompanied by smaller, lighter-weight supporting text and uppercase labels.
A persistent sticky navigation bar and a floating 'Ask AI' button maintain key interactions across scroll depth, while content sections simply scroll into view without additional reveal animations.
Feature sections often present information in a split layout, with a large visual representation of the product UI on one side and concise benefit-oriented text on the other.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-width video background that plays silently, creating a dynamic yet subtle backdrop for the main headline and calls to action.

Key information and feature descriptions are presented in visually distinct cards or asymmetrical two-column layouts, often integrating high-fidelity product UI screenshots to illustrate functionality.
The site employs a sticky header navigation and a persistent floating action button ('Ask AI') to ensure critical actions and navigation are always accessible regardless of scroll position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, often accompanied by smaller, lighter-weight supporting text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; buttons and cards feature rounded corners, while embedded UI screenshots also maintain a rounded aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; sections have generous vertical padding, and content within sections is well-distributed with ample negative space.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-fidelity product UI screenshots, seamlessly integrated into the hero and feature sections, immediately communicates the product's functionality and appeals directly to a developer audience. This visual emphasis on the actual product experience sets it apart from more abstract marketing sites.
